title: What my Zendesk spec forgot: 24/24 checks passed, 21 gaps found #shorts
description:
Claude built a Zendesk alternative, a small-team help desk, from one written spec. All 24 acceptance checks passed, and the build exposed 21 gaps in the spec. The surprise: a seeded ticket sat exactly on the Due soon line, so both answers were defensible, and a reopened ticket could stay assigned to a deactivated agent. Every gap is now fixed in the spec. Still not tested: real sign-in, real email, a real scheduler and hosting.

Full build test (2:31): https://youtu.be/P6Hpn74n8G0
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/help-desk
Zendesk pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/zendesk

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.
